description: Main script for Twister testing framework, handling setup, environment discovery, test plan execution, reporting, and optional coverage and artifact packaging.

classes.name: TestPlan
classes.description: Represents the test plan, manages discovery, loading, and reporting of tests.

classes.name: Reporting
classes.description: Handles generation of test reports, footprints, summaries, and saving reports.

classes.name: HardwareMap
classes.description: Manages hardware discovery, device mapping, and hardware summaries.

classes.name: TwisterEnv
classes.description: Represents the testing environment configuration and discovery.

classes.name: TwisterRunner
classes.description: Executes test instances and collects results.

methods.name: setup_logging
methods.description: Configures logging handlers and formatters based on output directory, log file, verbosity, and timestamps.

methods.name: init_color
methods.description: Initializes colorama with optional stripping of color.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the testing script, orchestrates environment setup, test discovery, execution, reporting, coverage, and cleanup.
